gap.reason: Same value, governed token: a gap Figma leaves unbound at 0 is the none of its family, and SOLAR picks the family by direction, as its own bound gaps do: a horizontal auto layout's gap is an inset, a vertical one's a stack (the Foundations agent reference and the Spatial chapter). Decided once here, as the paddings are.

docs.description: The numbered or ticked circle that marks one step's status inside Stepper. 4 variants: status (upcoming, active, completed, error). Building block of Step; not used on its own.

rules.reason: The circle that marks one step's status in a Stepper, its description says: a tick when completed, its number when active or upcoming, a "!" in error. Drawn with the shared layer helpers on both platforms; a part of a Step, not used on its own.
An upcoming step's circle and an erring one's are edged; a completed and an active one are filled and not, as Figma draws each.
